brief:
@Override
    public long skip(long n) throws IOException{}
method_comment:
* Skips up to {@code n} bytes. Returns the actual number of bytes skipped, * which may be less than requested if the end of stream is reached. *

* This method does NOT throw {@link java.io.EOFException} if fewer bytes * are available. Callers must check the return value to determine how many * bytes were actually skipped. * * @param n the number of bytes to skip * @return the actual number of bytes skipped (may be less than {@code n})
